stx.text: Zimone Wola is a prodigy at Strixhaven who, on the last day of exams, learns that a package has arrived from her grandmother, as one has every year for seven years, and she has chosen Quandrix while her friends choose Prismari and Silverquill.
Following her grandmother's notes, Zimone learns that Nimiroti solved the Vorzani Conjecture and was captured by the Oriq, who now want Zimone's knowledge too.

When Extus offers to share the Oriq's secrets so they can control the universe, she refuses and fights him with the ribbon braid, helped by Dean Kianne, but a rumor that she is an Oriq recruit makes her friends avoid her.
Zimone at last finds Nimiroti at the Sanctuary of the Lost, where her grandmother no longer remembers her but says she is someone she loves.

dsk.text: Zimone Wola, a Quandrix student sent by Niv-Mizzet to wait for Kaito, joins Kaito, Tyvar, Niko and the Wanderer as they enter a strange house in search of Nashi.

Inside, the door they came through vanishes and Zimone realizes the House rearranges itself, then she chases Tyvar when he runs toward a cry for help, and a wall of moths separates the two from the others.
Zimone and Tyvar find Marina Vendrell, whose diary shows she enabled Valgavoth to take over the plane, and Zimone concludes that Valgavoth has swallowed everything beyond the House.
They rescue Nashi, Niko and the Wanderer from the cult and escape through an Omenpath Kaito opens from Ravnica.
